title: NIKATRU content-pack recipe
_readme: [pipeline 7]P-1. THE REQUIRED SET LIVES HERE, IN THE REPOSITORY, and it is the
right-hand side of assert-recipe-contract.mjs's fixture-parity check: one recorded
failing recipe per entry in `required` below, and COVERAGE LOST the moment
required[].length exceeds the fixture count. The original acceptance criterion was
'refuses a recipe missing any required field', which names no set and is satisfied
This is deliberately NOT a JSON-Schema-library schema. Nothing in this repo's
tooling has a JSON Schema validator and adding one would be a dependency for a
dozen rules; recipe.mjs walks these declarations directly. The vocabulary is kept
JSON-Schema-shaped so it can be handed to a real validator later without a rewrite.

recipe_version.description: The recipe grammar this file is written against. An integer, not the pack's semver — a recipe and the pack it produces version independently.

pack_id.description: Becomes manifest.pack_id, which the client binds to what it asked for (ContentPackLoader.loadFrom expectPackId). Usually the app id.

pack_version.description: The immutable semver of the pack this recipe produces (ADR 007).

locales.description: BCP-47 tags. minItems 1 is P-8's REQUIRED_COVERAGE: an empty locales array is itself a failure, because the original criterion compared content.json against a list the same author wrote and an empty list matches anything.

modalities.description: 🔴 THIS ENUM IS THE GRAMMAR, NOT THE CAPABILITY. `video` and `music` are legal WORDS and are not implemented: 39-CHASSIS §4 cut 8 leaves video dormant on an unanswered owner scope question, and [ADR 019] keeps music (Drift) deferred at the 🔴 risk tier. The gate is IMPLEMENTED_MODALITIES in src/recipe.mjs, which REFUSES anything outside it. Keeping the two lists separate is deliberate: if the grammar were the capability, deleting the implementation check would change no outcome and the check would be dead code reporting health. Mutation-proven 2026-08-02 — with the enums merged, disabling the implementation check was NOT CAUGHT.

licence_families.description: Every family in tooling/legal/content-licence-register.json this pack consumes. G-36: no asset ships without a cleared row, and the register is the left-hand side of that comparison.

review.description: P-4. `expert` forces 100% coverage regardless of sample_floor. The sample itself is DERIVED from the pack's content hash (src/sample.mjs), so a free-hand sample fails.

asset.description: Relative path under the recipe's assets/ dir. Required for image and audio items, forbidden for text items.

endpoint.description: 🔴 BATCH ONLY, and it is a validate-time refusal on purpose. [ADR 017] locks MP3; the streaming synthesis endpoint cannot emit MP3 at all, so a streaming recipe can NEVER satisfy the format lock. Catching that here costs nothing; catching it asset-by-asset at the end of an expensive metered run costs the run.

audio_encoding.description: [ADR 017]: MP3, whose patents expired April 2017 — the only format definitively unencumbered and natively decodable on all six platforms. Declared explicitly because LINEAR16 is the vendor default, i.e. the off-format asset arrives precisely when nobody set this.
